_comment: Bundled model-pricing table. Prices are USD per 1M tokens, written as JSON strings
so they parse losslessly as Decimals. Every entry records the real date and provider
source used to verify it. The top-level generated date is only when this document was
emitted; it does not imply that every entry was re-verified.
Standard on-demand tier only: batch discounts, cache-hit rates, long-context tiers
(Gemini and Claude price >200k-token prompts higher), and per-request search fees
(Perplexity) are not modelled — use capability_overrides where they matter.
The weekly checker is a read-only drift tripwire. Direct machine-readable catalogs
and secondary signals can trigger review, but only provider-owned current pricing
documentation plus human review authorizes a rate or last_verified change. Exhaustive
provider coverage posture and reasons live in scripts/pricing_check.py and are checked
by scripts/validate_pricing.py; unchecked or unrepresentable pricing is never guessed.
